neighbours.label: the word ' term(s)' introducing a definition ('the term X means', 'definitions of terms')
fire: As used in this section, the term qualified buyer means any person who holds a licence.
For the purposes of this agreement, the term affiliate means a company under common control.
Definitions of terms. Unless the context requires otherwise, the following apply.
All terms used in the claims are to be given their ordinary meaning.
In this chapter, the term small business means a firm with fewer than fifty employees.
The term vessel includes every kind of watercraft used for transport.
Capitalized terms not defined here have the meanings given in the lease.
Under this rule, the term dealer refers to any person who sells firearms.
quiet: As used in this section, a qualified buyer must hold a valid licence.
For the purposes of this agreement, each affiliate shall pay its own costs.
General provisions. Unless the parties agree otherwise, the following apply.
All claims must be filed within ninety days of the decision.
In this chapter, a small business may apply for a reduced fee.
Every vessel must carry life jackets for each passenger on board.
Late payments not received here will incur a fee under the lease.
Under this rule, any dealer who sells firearms must keep records.
